notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE
notes.content:
We present you a fresh update of our game, filled with new animations, visual improvements and exciting features!

Lots of new animations! More than a dozen new animations have been added to the game.  We've worked hard to bring more life to the game world.

Visual overhaul. We've revisited some old backgrounds and sprites, giving them a fresh look.

Steam Achievements Unlocked! We've synced our in-game achievements with Steam, so you can now earn Steam achievements as you progress through the game. Show off your gaming skills to the world!

Error corrections and text edits. We also fixed some annoying bugs and corrected errors in the game text. This update should make the game more enjoyable and understandable for all players.

Thank you for your continued support and we hope you enjoy this latest update!

Let us know if you want us to make any changes!
